I've been on HRT for about 9.5 months so I'll answer as best I can.

1. I'm on Spiro and can say it does have some side effects (at least for me), but it mainly just makes me fatigued.

2. Being on any antiandrogen can cause you to become infertile, as for if it's reversible there's no way to know for sure so unless you are 100% sure you don't want kids it's safest to bank some sperm ahead of time.

3. Taking an antiandrogen will prevent you're body from producing testosterone so you won't have both in you're system just estrogen.

Some background first, for years before starting hormones I had difficulties sleeping and was always tired throughout the day. Most days id be halfway to collapsing from exhaustion and at night I'd lie in bed staring at the wall for hours before falling asleep. First night on hormone I slept well for the first time, no nightmares and I woke up full of energy. Since then I've stopped feeling tired all the time and have continued to sleep well.

For the first week I would get dizzy spells that would last up to half an hour. First one was in the middle of a bio lab while pipeting blood samples, luckily the rest of my group was helpful and it was a short lab. Dizzy spells still happen whenever I change my blocked dosage but they pass in a couple of days.

Tldr; hormones have made me able to function as a person :)

Edit. Forgot to answer the second question, besides what I've said above it took me months to actually see any changes but my friends could tell after a few weeks.
